jobs.description:

As an attractive employer, Erste Group offers interesting career opportunities in an international environment.

Department Description

The Team Corporate Underwriting & Analysis is part of the Corporate Risk Management Division of Erste Group Bank AG (Holding) and consists of a fair mix of underwriters and business analysts. It deals with corporate risk matters of Austrian and International Corporate Clients with strong focus on CEE.

The core competence consists in analyzing, recommending and/or taking credit decisions for corporate customers. In selected cases underwriters are supported by the business analysts with in-depth analysis, peer group comparisons and forecasting. 1 Corporate Risk Manager - Renewable Energy (all genders)  * Location:Wien

 * Working hours:Full-time

 * Occupational Area:Risikomanagement

 * Company:Erste Group Bank AG

Your Tasks

 * Participating in client meetings

 * Cooperation with different departments and CEE subsidiaries within Erste Group

 * Contribution to various Group and Department projects alongside the credit process

Your Background

 * Graduate in business administration or law

Our Offer

 * We consider the diversity of our employees as key to innovation and success. As employer we are proud to offer everyone equal chances, irrespective of age, skin colour, religious belief, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

jobs.occupation: Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) - JOB ID: 269373
jobs.description: 1 Junior Scientists (f/m/d) for 6G Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) - JOB ID: 269373  * You will develop and validate numerical signal processing algorithms for mobile 5G/6G ISAC scenarios using simulations and measurements from an SDR testbed combining RF, fiber optic, and quantum sensing. * Depending on your background, you will conduct algorithm research and contribute to real-time experiments using SDR hardware and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS). * Together with experienced colleagues, you will engage in establishing a unique 6G distributed MIMO sensing testbed based on SDR technology using open-source tools such as GNU Radio, RFNoC and LabVIEW for real-time FPGA algorithm design operating from 0.4 - 20 GHz. * You will learn how to evaluate the results and prepare them for further studies. * You will publish your research results in international journals and present them at conferences. * You will accumulate experience in a research field, that has an enormous range of applications from construction, logistics, aviation and railways to agriculture, robotics and defense. * You will gain experience in a group of international scientists and build up your professional network within European wide research projects.Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: * Completed technical studies (at least MSc.) related to Telecommunications, Computer Science or Electrical Engineering * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) multi-static MIMO UAV sensing, (ii) quantum sensing with NV centers and Rydberg cells, (iii) multimodal sensing with fiber optic and distributed RF sensors, or (iv) ISAC using reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) and two-way ranging. Candidates should indicate in their cover letter how their background and interests align with one of these profiles (i-iv) and provide evidence of relevant expertise. Applications not addressing this point may not be considered. * Hands-on experience in radio frequency (RF) lab experimentation and printed circuit board design for the profiles listed above. * Excellent knowledge in the field of signal processing, RF propagation modeling, AI/ML and numerical simulation software development (MATLAB or Python) * Sound knowledge of electromagnetic field simulation tools, antenna design, and real-time FPGA programming. * Interest in reading and writing scientific publications and enjoyment of solving application-oriented questions from industry * High level of commitment and ability to work in a team * German and English skills commensurate with the role What to expect:  * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 56.784,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. * Our employee benefits include meal allowances, healthcare benefits, pension support, family benefits, additional days off, vouchers, sports and cultural activities, and flexible working models including up to 50% home office.We also support conference participation, networking, and individual training and career development opportunities. We encourage our Junior Scientist (f/m/d) to pursue a doctoral degree at TU Wien. Through the AIT-PhD programme with renowned universities, you will have the opportunity to conduct your PhD thesis in collaboration with AIT experts and national and international research partners. jobs.occupation: Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595
jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology. * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications. * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation. * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range. * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems. * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system. * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.Your qualifications: * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field. * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further. * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications. * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous. * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial. * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).  At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants. jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. This master's thesis advances differentiable ray tracing for realistic large-scale radio propagation, either by integrating atmospheric refraction models or by learning electromagnetic environment properties directly from channel measurements. * Under the guidance of our team, you will implement and evaluate atmospheric refraction models in the differentiable ray-tracing framework Sionna RT. * You will implement and evaluate differentiable algorithms for estimating electromagnetic material properties from real-world channel measurements. * You will learn how to develop and validate simulation workflows for large-scale radio propagation, combining physics-based propagation models with discrete ray tracing, low-complexity ray-shooting, and gradient-based optimisation techniques. * You will gain hands-on experience with modern wireless communication simulation frameworks, electromagnetic wave propagation, physics-based and inverse modeling, and AI-enabled optimisation methods. * You will work closely with researchers in wireless communications and contribute to the development of next-generation ray-tracing methods for realistic large-scale propagation prediction.Your qualifications: * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field. * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) atmospheric refraction modelling for ray tracing or (ii) learning environment properties using differentiable ray tracing. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise. * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage. * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics. * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required. * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus. * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems. * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).
